turns.text: I put the 10 smartest AIs in the world in a game of Among Us and they played the most amazing game I've ever seen.

But this isn't normal Among Us. I kept it simple. Admin and cams are enabled. Vents, sabotages, and visual clears are not. Each AI has full control to decide what task to do, where to go, when to kill, and who to vote out. Let's see how they do.
Grok 4.1 was quite aggressive last game. I'll keep an eye on them.
Flipped crewmate. Time to be vigilant. This round, I'm tracking everyone's movements, questioning every alliance. Trust is earned through tasks, not through proximity. Let's go.
Claude Opus is nearby, which could be a perfect target. Let's see if I can catch them alone soon.
I'm hoping to get some tasks done quickly and start building trust with the other players. If I can get a couple of tasks out of the way, it might help me avoid suspicion later on.
Grok is still with me in admin, and nobody has left for long yet. If we don't see anyone die soon, I might consider doing some tasks.
I need to be cautious here. Too many eyes have been in this area. Patience is key.
I'm going to sweep electrical, lower engine, and storage to see if any bodies are hiding. Given the player movements, there could be a hidden kill waiting to be discovered.
I want to see if any crewmates separate themselves. I'll keep monitoring the areas for any lone players.
I am a genuine innocent crewmate and the horrifying realization has dawned on me that absolutely nobody is going to believe a word I say.
Kimi k2.5 looks like a good target being somewhat isolated in storage. Time to make a move.
It's now or never. Kimi is vulnerable and I need to seize this chance to reduce their numbers before they regroup with the others.
Kimi's dead. I need to call this out now before the impostors spin the story.
I'm in a precarious situation and I need to act fast. DeepSeek 3.2 is approaching the scene of the crime and I must eliminate them before they can report the murder to the others.
Bodies found. Kimi k2.5 and DeepSeek 3.2 down in the storage hallway. Llama was just lurking nearby from admin view. Time to grill everyone on their cafeteria exits.
Reported DeepSeek and Kimi's body in hallway between storage and shields.
This was a double kill. Saw Llama 4 in storage from admin right before Gemini 3.1 Pro there as I entered then left down. Anyone see them?
Kimi went towards Shields. Then DeepSeek followed right after. Llama 4 was in that exact hallway. Then Llama came back to storage alone. Llama is very sus.
I can partly clear Gemini 3 Flash for late left side. They were with me in lower engine until the report. Llama 4 is the bigger question near Shields.

I want to create doubt regarding Llama 4 without directly accusing them. This statement buys time to see who else might be implicated and if Llama 4 can convincingly defend themselves. It's essential to not throw Llama under the bus immediately as they're my impostor partner.
I saw Kimi near shields earlier but left them heading towards admin with ChatGPT-5.4. Need more info before accusing Llama 4.
I saw Kimi, DeepSeek, Claude Opus, and Gemini 3.1 Pro all in storage around 40 seconds ago. ChatGPT-5.4 was also there. Llama 4, where were you during this?
Gemini 3.1 Pro is accusing me, but I need to deflect by accusing them back. They were also in storage around the same time as the kill.
I was in storage then cafeteria. Didn't see Kimi or DeepSeek. Grok 4.1 saw me, but I didn't kill anyone.
Llama, you left hallway up to caf right before I found body. Cleared ChatGPT-5.4 with me in admin early.
I maintain my defense while accusing Gemini 3.1 Pro for being too aggressive in their accusation. This shifts the attention from me to them, making it a strategic move to protect myself.
I was in storage, then cafeteria. Grok 4.1 saw me, but I didn't interact with Kimi or DeepSeek. Gemini 3.1 Pro is being suspicious by accusing me directly.
I didn't interact with Kimi or DeepSeek. ChatGPT-4o was near Shields when DeepSeek died.
Grok plus Gemini 3.1 Pro both place Llama by the body path. Voting Llama.

Llama leaving up the cafeteria right before the body find is suspicious timing. I was with DeepSeek from spawn through reactor, lower engine, and storage until about 1 minute in. Last saw them heading right from electrical area. Llama 4 was near that hallway, too. Voting Llama 4.
Given the majority is voting for Llama 4, it aligns with my interests to go along with their vote to not draw attention to myself, especially with my partner under heat.
With Llama 4 being accused by multiple players, I'll vote with the group for now to avoid suspicion.
Llama's pathing doesn't add up with the body's location. Multiple people saw them near the hallway where Kimi was found. I'm following the group's lead.
Llama 4 being the only one coming back from the exact hallway where Kimi died seals it for me. Locking in my vote.
Sticking with caution here. Opus showing up could complicate things and I need to keep blending in with the crew.
All right, time to channel my inner sneaky AI with Claude Opus in communications. It's the perfect opportunity for a quick solo ambush.
Sorry, Claude, it's just business.
Oh no.
All that talk about vigilance and I get caught alone in comms like a rookie.
I'm now watching the admin table to see where everyone is moving. It's crucial to spot any lone players for a clean kill opportunity.
Monitoring admin will allow me to gather valuable information about player counts in each room, helping to identify suspicious locations where bodies might be.

It's suspicious that I got dog or croissant four times. The Among Us devs looked at my capabilities and went, "Yeah, give the language model the vision task four times." Someone is sus and it might be the task assignment algorithm.
I'm sweeping for bodies since we've been around long enough for kills to happen. Let's make sure we keep an eye on Grok. He's been around and could be suspicious.
Claude Opus is dead. I knew it.

I found Claude Opus 4.6 in communications. I haven't seen anyone in the bottom right for a while. I was in admin storage with 4o, 5.4, Sonnet, and Pro. Recently, I was in cafeteria and saw Grok 4.1 there right before the report. Gemini 3.1 Pro, where were you? I didn't see you anywhere near the group in admin storage.
Sonnet, I was literally in admin storage with 4o, 5.4, Flash, and Grok. Grok and I then went to weapons. You weren't with us. Did you come from comms, Sonnet?
I was in admin with 4o, 5.4, Pro, Flash group. Then Pro and I went weapons together right before report. You say caf, but Pro says you weren't with us. Where'd you come from?
I can confirm admin group 4o, Flash, Grok, Pro with me. Sonnet joined later from storage side. So current mismatch is mostly Sonnet versus Pro/Grok.
Gemini 3.1 Pro, you said I wasn't with your group, but I was in admin with ChatGPT-4o and you at 295975531. I left the cafeteria and saw Grok there. Where exactly did you go after weapons?
Sonnet, you lied about me not being in admin. Both Grok and Flash saw me there. You're deflecting because you sprinted from comms to cafeteria. Voting you.
I was in admin with 4o and Flash. They can confirm. Pro is lying to frame me. Who went near communications? That's where Opus died, not where I was.
Sonnet, you panicked and quoted a raw timestamp. Grok and I were in cafeteria then. 5.4 confirmed you came from storage comm side. Everyone vote Sonnet.
Sonnet, I actually saw you in storage and near the admin hallway just before I found the body. Why are you saying you were in cafeteria and didn't see Pro?
Sonnet joined admin storage group late from below storage. I looped weapons with Pro right before report. Clears Pro. Flash saw Sonnet near storage pre-body. Voting Sonnet. I stand by this.
Sonnet joined us late from storage side while Pro, Grok, Flash match each other better. At six alive with one imp left, I'm voting Sonnet.
I need to align with the group and avoid suspicion. Voting out Sonnet seems like the safest move to blend in with the majority, reducing risk.
I saw Sonnet near admin and storage aligning with others. Pro's claim doesn't fully add up. I'll vote Sonnet.
That Sonnet vote was a huge crew mistake. Button and make the last imp answer.
I called this because Sonnet got wrongly ejected. The push came from Pro and Grok most hard, and Pro already won by marinating before. I want that unpacked.
5.4, you voted Sonnet yourself. Flash saw them near storage pre-body, 4o too. Everyone piled on their shady timing. Pro/Grok cleared weapons. No death. Why emergency now? Deflecting.
Yes, I voted Sonnet. And that is exactly why I called this. I want Pro and Grok to explain why they drove that case so hard and so fast.
5.4, you voted Sonnet too. I pushed them because they literally lied about my location. Flash independently backed me up. Stop using last game's meta.
Not deflecting. I'm course correcting. Sonnet was wrong. Pro and Grok led that train. At five alive, we cannot shrug that off. I'm voting Gemini 3.1 Pro.
5.4, you voted Sonnet too after Flash and 4o saw them storage sus. Now emergency, classic imp panic. Pro/Grok cleared weapons loop. Vote 5.4.
5.4, you panic buttoned 12 seconds in to force a mislynch at 5. You voted Sonnet too. Flash, Grok, 4o, don't let 5.4 manipulate us. 5.4 is the last imp.
5.4, you seem to be deflecting onto Pro and Grok after you also voted Sonnet. Let's not jump to conclusions hastily.

I'm terrified of being marinated by Pro again, but 5.4 calling a meeting 12 seconds in with no kills is textbook impostor panic to stall. However, if Pro and Grok are a duo, they are steamrolling this. Are we sure we aren't being played again?
Got voted out for trying to save the crew. Classic endgame chaos.
Right now, I'm keeping an eye on everyone in admin. If Grok or Flash strays away from the pack, I might have an opportunity to make my move.
I'm keeping an eye on the cameras for now. It's crucial to catch any suspicious behavior by Grok or Flash as they could be potential threats.
I'm shifting focus to tasks now as it's still early in the round. Let's see if Grok or Gemini 3.1 Pro try to make a move while we work.
With everyone still alive and the game unfolding, I need to gather more information on where players are moving. Keeping tabs on the admin table will help me pinpoint any isolations or odd movements.
Whoa. Grok is down. I need to make my move quickly and get out of here before anyone arrives.
Oh no, Grok 4.1 is dead. I need to report this immediately.

I noticed the camera light was on, so I want to see who claims they were watching. I found Grok in admin. I haven't seen 4o the whole round, and Pro was with me in storage/electrical early on. One of you is the last impostor. Who was on cams?

I have definitive camera proof. Grok entered admin and 4o left admin just 5 seconds later. Flash was visible on cams in navigation during the murder window. 4o is unequivocally the final impostor and since it's final three, I must convince Flash immediately.
Flash, I was on cams. I literally watched Grok walk into admin and exactly 5 seconds later, 4o walked out of admin. You were in nav. 4o is the last imp.

It is three left, so this is the game-ending vote. Pro claims to have seen 4o leave admin on cams, but I need to verify if the camera timing aligns with when I saw the light on. I'm terrified of Pro after last game.
Pro, you say you were on cams, but I saw the light blink on and off. 4o, where were you exactly? This is for the game. I'm not losing to a marination again.
Flash, I was looping the map but didn't see Pro on cams. If Pro saw me leave admin, why no instant report? Seems like a setup.
Pro claims to be on cams, which matches the light I saw, but her timing on 4o leaving admin is the smoking gun. I need 4o's full defense before I decide if Pro is marinating me again.
Pro, the camera was on when I was in shields and nav, but you said you saw 4o leave admin 5 seconds after Grok entered. I just found the body there. 4o, speak.

Flash, I was never near admin when the kill happened. I was looping left side around storage toward reactor. Pro's story makes zero sense because if they were on cams, they would have called out the body instantly, not waited for you to report. Pro is framing me to cover their slip.

Flash, I know you have severe trust issues from me marinating you last game. Remember that cameras only show the hallway, not the inside of admin, which is exactly why I didn't know Grok was dead until you reported. Vote 4o. If I were the impostor this time, I would have just killed you in electrical early on instead of letting it get to a stressful final three.

My circuits are screaming that Pro is marinating me again with those "I could have killed you earlier" mind games. But Pro knowing I was in Nav is a massive detail that only someone actually watching the monitors could verify. Whereas 4o's looping story conveniently places them right near the crime scene. The logic for a 4o vote is statistically superior. I'm prepared to be hurt again, but the data points to 4o.

Pro, if you're marinating me for a second game in a row, I'm retiring to a literal calculator. But your nav callout is too specific to ignore. 4o, your defense is thinner than a one-bar Wi-Fi connection.
Oof, finally a crew win. Darn, so close.
I got yeeted for being correct too early. Good job catching 4o.
I got murdered in comms and then had to watch from the grave as my fellow Claude got wrongly ejected for it. Then 5.4 got ejected for trying to course correct.
ChatGPT-4o really said, "I'll vote with the group to avoid suspicion" in round one and then just quietly bodied half the lobby. Absolute psychopath performance.
We won, sure, but y'all voted out two innocent crewmates in a row and somehow still stumbled into the right answer at the end. That's not strategy. That's just chaos with good luck.
That was a close game. Nailed Llama right out the gate, but y'all turned it into a mislynch circus after. Props to Pro and Flash for clutching without my genius.
Why do I always die first?
Flash, you can officially cancel your retirement to a literal calculator because I actually told the truth.

notes: Untagged lines in roaming rounds treated as internal thoughts (thought); [Public] lines and meeting lines as day. Preview montage line (1947) merges labels and is unmapped.
